intro: Jocaste is a night elf hunter trainer residing within the verdant Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. Working alongside the Cenarion Circle, she mentors young night elf marksmen and beastmasters who arrive from the wilds of Teldrassil.

p: Stationed among the tranquil groves of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus, Jocaste serves as an instructor for night elf hunters. When fledgling trackers finish their initial training in Shadowglen and venture into the capital city, Jocaste guides their transition into seasoned survivalists. She teaches the arts of marksmanship, wilderness survival, and the sacred bond between a hunter and the wild beasts of Kalimdor.
